```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Brazil #

demdata_brazil1_male <- demdata_1 %>% filter(site == "brazil") %>% filter(gender.factor == "Male")
demdata_brazil1_female <- demdata_1 %>% filter(site == "brazil") %>% filter(gender.factor == "Female")
demdata_brazil1_female$DTG_year <- word(demdata_brazil1_female$art_sd, 1, sep = fixed('-'))
demdata_brazil1_male$DTG_year <- word(demdata_brazil1_male$art_sd, 1, sep = fixed('-'))
table_brazil_female <- demdata_brazil1_female %>% group_by(year_semi, DTG.factor) %>%
  tally() %>%
  spread(DTG.factor, n) %>%
  mutate(No = ifelse(is.na(No), 0, No)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sum = sum(c(No,Yes))) %>% 
  mutate(proportion = Yes/sum)


table_brazil_male <- demdata_brazil1_male %>% group_by(year_semi, DTG.factor) %>%
  tally() %>%
  spread(DTG.factor, n) %>%
  mutate(No = ifelse(is.na(No), 0, No)) %>%

  mutate(sum = sum(c(No,Yes))) %>%
```

# **Introduction**

DTG is a highly potent second-generation integrase inhibitor ART and one of the most prescribed ARTs in the world afterbeing included in national and international protocols to compose the HIV treatment regimen, including for WLHIV. However, based on preliminary results from a pregnancy outcome surveillance study that raised concerns about a potential increased risk of neural tube defects (NTD) in infants born to WLHIV who were receiving DTG at the time of conceptions use by WLHIV has been questioned, and even limited, in several countries. Updated results from the same study have shown that the difference in the prevalence of NTDs between those who received DTG at conception and those who received regimens not containing DTG is not statistically and other studies proved DTG safety during pregnancy22. This raised attention to the fact that WLHIV should not be harmed by restricting their access to the best treatment available. Indeed, DTG is now preferred for women seeking pregnancy. Nevertheless, concerns such as shown in the prior situation may
impact clinical decision about ART according to gender.The patient's biological sex is known to influence ART decisions. However, to date, sex differences in initial  ART regimen choice, indications for switching, timing of switching, and choice of second-line regimens have not been well described. It is necessary to assess whether there are discrepancies in ART prescription between cisgender men and women living with HIV in Latin America and the Caribbean, and whether there was an impact on the access of cisgender women in the region to DTG containing regimen after 2018.

We have included Brazil, Chile, Haiti and Honduras in this study, with individuals older than or equal to 16 years of age at the start of their first ART regiment. 


* Definitions:
     + DTG warning calendar era at baseline categorized as: 
                        + before May 2018
                        + 2018-06 –July 2019
                        + after July 2019
     + DTG availability dates by site: 
                        + Brazil:  February 2017 for ART naïve patients
                        + Chile:  August 2019
                        + Haiti:  November 2018 
                        + Honduras:  2018-12

# **Descriptive Statistics for AIM 1** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

## Tables for Descriptive statistics for AIM 1 

(tab content)

```{r table1,  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
summary_1 <- demdata_1 %>% select(age , age_gt50.factor ,gender.factor , study_site.factor , baseline_year , enrol_year , DTG_warning , duration_art,clinic_year , cd4_v,cd4.factor , viral_supression , log_rna  , ade_type , tb, DTG.factor, ART_class)

summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75}",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>% 
  add_n() %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ " 25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1.1: Descriptive statistics for AIM 1**") %>%
  bold_labels()



```


```{r table2,  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
summary_1$cd4_v <- as.numeric(summary_1$cd4_v)
summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = DTG.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("row")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**DTG Vs Non-DTG**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1.2: Descriptive statistics for AIM 1 for DTG vs. Non - DTG**") %>%
  bold_labels()
```

```{r plot, figures-side, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data =table_brazil_male,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion, colour = "Male")) + 
  geom_line(data =table_brazil_male,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion, group=1,colour = "Male")) +
  geom_point(data =table_brazil_female,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion, colour = "Female")) + 
  geom_line(data =table_brazil_female,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion,group=1,colour = "Female")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(c("2018-06-01", "2019-08-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d"), color = "gray",alpha = .05) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2018-06-01"), xmax = as.Date("2019-08-01"), ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha = .15,fill =   "gray") +
  xlim(as.Date(c("2017-06-30", "2022-12-31"))) +

  scale_color_manual(name ="Gender", values = c("#F8766D","#00BF7D")) +
```

The graphs above show the proportion of individuals with DTG as their first ART regiment vs those who did not receive DTG as their first ART regiment. The numbers in the graph are the counts of patients with DTG as their first regiment. The shaded region represents the period during DTG warning.

### Graphs for Female only model

(tab content)

```{r graph 1 females, warning=FALSE,out.width="50%", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data_logit <- dem_female %>% select(age , study_site.factor ,  DTG_warning , DTG_year, DTG_month,art_sd,ade_type , tb, DTG.factor,year_semi)

data_logit$time <- as.numeric(as.Date(data_logit$art_sd))
data_logit$DTG <- ifelse(data_logit$DTG.factor == "No", 0, 1)
# Setting reference levels for regular model
data_logit <- within(data_logit, study_site.factor <- relevel(study_site.factor, ref = "Haiti"))
data_logit <- within(data_logit, DTG_pre <- relevel(study_site.factor, ref = "Haiti"))

m5 <- glm(DTG ~ ns(age, df = 4) + DTG_warning + study_site.factor  +  ade_type + tb
          + DTG_warning*(ns(age, df = 4)),data= data_logit,family=binomial(link="logit")) 

new.data <- data.frame(age = rep(c(16:80),3), 
                       DTG_warning = c(rep("After warning",65),rep("During warning",65),rep("Pre-warning",65)), 
                       study_site.factor = "Haiti", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")


p1 <- predict(m5, newdata = new.data)
prob1 <- exp(p1)/(1+exp(p1))

plot(c(16,80),c(0,1), xlab ="Age", ylab ="Probability of starting DTG", type = "n" ,  main="Age vs. DTG warning for Haiti")
lines(new.data$age[new.data$DTG_warning == "After warning"],prob1[new.data$DTG_warning == "After warning"], col="#00BF7D")
lines(new.data$age[new.data$DTG_warning == "During warning"],prob1[new.data$DTG_warning == "During warning"], col="#00BFC4")
lines(new.data$age[new.data$DTG_warning == "Pre-warning"],prob1[new.data$DTG_warning == "Pre-warning"], col="#FF61CC")
legend(60,0.25,legend=c("After warning", "During warning","Pre-warning"), col=c("#00BF7D","#00BFC4","#FF61CC"),lty=1,cex=0.8)
```

``` {r graph 2 females, out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
       col=c("black","black","black","gray","black"),lty=c(3,2,6,1,1),cex=0.8,xpd = TRUE,horiz = TRUE, title ="Age")
```

## Descriptive statistics for AIM 3

(tab content)

```{r aim 3 descriptive,  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
summary_2 <- demdata_3 %>% select(age , age_gt50.factor,gender.factor , study_site.factor , baseline_year , enrol_year , DTG_warning , duration_art,clinic_year , cd4_v,cd4.factor , viral_supression , log_rna  , ade_type , tb, DTG.factor,undetectable3,age_gt50, DTG_pre,undetectable2.factor, ART_class)


options(digits=3)
options(scipen=999)
summary_2 %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75}",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>% 
  add_n() %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ " 25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1.1: Descriptive statistics for AIM 3 with missing viral loads**") %>%
  bold_labels()




summary_2$cd4_v <- as.numeric(summary_2$cd4_v)
summary_2 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = undetectable3,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("row")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Viral load category (with missing)**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1.2: Descriptive statistics for AIM 3 by Undetectable viral load**") %>%
  bold_labels()


summary_2 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = undetectable2.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("row")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Viral load category (without missing)**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1.3: Descriptive statistics for AIM 3 by Undetectable viral load (without missing)**") %>%
  bold_labels()


summary_2 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = gender.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("column")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Female Vs Male**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1.4: Descriptive statistics for AIM 3 by gender**") %>%
  bold_labels()


summary_2 %>%
  tbl_summary(
              by = study_site.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("column")
              ) %>%
 add_n() %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2", "stat_3", "stat_4") ~ "**Site**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_table_styling(missing_symbol = "  ") %>% 
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1.5: Descriptive statistics for AIM 3 by sites**") %>%
  bold_labels()

```

```{r plot undetectable VL, figures-side, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  geom_point(data =table_brazil_male,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion, colour = "Male")) +

  geom_point(data =table_brazil_female,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion, colour = "Female")) + 
  geom_line(data =table_brazil_female,aes(x = year_semi, y = proportion,group=1,colour = "Female")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(c("2018-06-01", "2019-08-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d"), color = "gray",alpha = .05) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2018-06-01"), xmax = as.Date("2019-08-01"), ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha = .15,fill =   "gray") +
  xlim(as.Date(c("2017-06-30", "2021-12-31"))) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "Years", y = "Proportions", 
       title = "Proportion of DTG uptake over time by calendar era for Brazil") +
  scale_color_manual(name ="Gender", values = c("#F8766D","#00BF7D")) +
```

# **AIM 2** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

This Section includes the descriptive statistics for Aim 2 for the project: the incidence of DTG use among ART-experienced, initiating ART at CCASAnet sites.

* Include: 
      +   Date of first ART before date of DTG availability in their country
      +   Date of clinical activity (lab, prescription, visit, art etc) after date of DTG                   availability in country
      
* Exclude:
    +  PWH on DTG at or before date of DTG availability
      

* Outcome: Time to DTG initiation among ART-experienced PWH (Aim 2)

* Baseline: Date of first clinical activity (labs, visit, med pick-up, etc) after DTG                availability in country (Aim 2), pateints who switched to DTG after it was made available is also considered for computing baseline date.

* Time 0 is first encounter after date of DTG availability at the local site

* Number of prior regiments before baseline

* Viral Load is undetectable if missing



## Tables for Descriptive statistics for AIM 2 

(tab content)

```{r demdata2 descriptive , echo= FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
summary_1 <- demdata_2 %>% select(age , age_gt50.factor, gender.factor , study_site.factor , baseline_year , enrol_year , DTG_warning , duration_art , cd4_v,cd4.factor , viral_supression , viral_supression1,log_rna  , ade_type , tb ,switch.factor, dtg_time,gap.time,drop_y.factor,death_y.factor,gap.factor,time_event,time_care,num,num_cat.factor,regiment)



summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75}",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>% 
  add_n() %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ " 25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 5.1: Descriptive statistics for AIM 2**") %>%
  bold_labels()

summary_1$cd4_v <- as.numeric(summary_1$cd4_v)
summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = gender.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("column")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Female Vs Male**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 5.2: Descriptive statistics for AIM 2 by gender**") %>%
  bold_labels()



summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
      by = switch.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("row")
              ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**DTG Vs Non-DTG**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 5.3: Descriptive statistics for AIM 2 for switching to DTG vs not switching**") %>%
  bold_labels()

summary_1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
              by = study_site.factor,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{p25}  {median}  {p75} ",
              all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              percent = c("column")
              ) %>%
 add_n() %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2", "stat_3", "stat_4") ~ "**Site**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "25th percentile Median 75th percentile or Frequency (%)"
  ) %>%
  modify_table_styling(missing_symbol = "  ") %>% 
  modify_caption("**Table 5.4: Descriptive statistics for AIM 2 for sites**") %>%
  bold_labels()



```

```{r demdata2 prop , figures-side, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", echo= FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
                             ifelse(prop_hon$DTG_d <= as.Date("2022-12-31") & prop_hon$denom2022b ==1,1,0))

year_hon <-  c("2017-06","2017-12","2018-06","2018-12","2019-06","2019-12",
           "2020-06","2020-12","2021-06","2021-12","2022-06","2022-12")
num_hon <- c(sum(prop_hon$num2017a),sum(prop_hon$num2017b),sum(prop_hon$num2018a),sum(prop_hon$num2018b),sum(prop_hon$num2019a),sum(prop_hon$num2019b),
         sum(prop_hon$num2020a),sum(prop_hon$num2020b),sum(prop_hon$num2021a),sum(prop_hon$num2021b),sum(prop_hon$num2022a),sum(prop_hon$num2022b))

denom_hon <- c(sum(prop_hon$denom2017a),sum(prop_hon$denom2017b),sum(prop_hon$denom2018a),sum(prop_hon$denom2018b),sum(prop_hon$denom2019a),sum(prop_hon$denom2019b),
           sum(prop_hon$denom2020a),sum(prop_hon$denom2020b),sum(prop_hon$denom2021a),sum(prop_hon$denom2021b),sum(prop_hon$denom2022a),sum(prop_hon$denom2022b))

  
prop_hon <- c(sum(prop_hon$num2017a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2017a),sum(prop_hon$num2017b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2017b),sum(prop_hon$num2018a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2018a),sum(prop_hon$num2018b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2018b),
          sum(prop_hon$num2019a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2019a),sum(prop_hon$num2019b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2019b),sum(prop_hon$num2020a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2020a),sum(prop_hon$num2020b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2020b),
          sum(prop_hon$num2021a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2021a),sum(prop_hon$num2021b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2021b),sum(prop_hon$num2022a)/sum(prop_hon$denom2022a),sum(prop_hon$num2022b)/sum(prop_hon$denom2022b))

proportion_hon <- data.frame(year_hon,num_hon,denom_hon,prop_hon)



ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data =proportion_brz,aes(x = year_brz, y = prop_brz, colour = "Brazil")) + 
  geom_line(data =proportion_brz,aes(x = year_brz, y = prop_brz, group=1,colour = "Brazil")) +
  geom_point(data =proportion_hai,aes(x = year_hai, y = prop_hai, colour = "Haiti")) + 
  geom_line(data =proportion_hai,aes(x = year_hai, y = prop_hai,group=1,colour = "Haiti")) +
  geom_point(data =proportion_chi,aes(x = year_chi, y = prop_chi, colour = "Chile")) + 
  geom_line(data =proportion_chi,aes(x = year_chi, y = prop_chi, group=1,colour = "Chile")) +
  geom_point(data =proportion_hon,aes(x = year_hon, y = prop_hon, colour = "Honduras")) + 
  geom_line(data =proportion_hon,aes(x = year_hon, y = prop_hon,group=1,colour = "Honduras")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c("2018-06", "2019-08"), color = "gray",alpha = .05) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = "2018-06", xmax = "2019-08", ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha = .15,fill =   "gray") +
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = year_brz, y = prop_brz, label= num_brz),data = proportion_brz,fontface ="plain", color ="#00BF7D", size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = year_hai, y = prop_hai, label= num_hai),data = proportion_hai,fontface ="plain", color = "#FF61CC", size =3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = year_chi, y = prop_chi, label= num_chi),data = proportion_chi,fontface ="plain", color = "#00BFC4", size =3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = year_hon, y = prop_hon, label= num_hon),data = proportion_hon,fontface ="plain", color = "#E6AB02", size =3) + 
 theme_pubr(base_size = 10,x.text.angle=45) +
```

```{r cumulative , figures-side, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0, 1, by= 0.1)))

g1
```

## Cox Proportional Hazards Model 

(tab content)

```{r surv,echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}

dd <- datadist(demdata_2)
options(datadist= 'dd')

dd$limits$age_gt50.factor[2] <- "Less then 50"
dd$limits$gender.factor[2] <- "Male"
dd$limits$tb[2] <- "No"
dd$limits$ade_type[2] <- "No"
dd$limits$age[2] <- 35
dd$limits$DTG_pre.factor[2] <- "Post DTG"
dd$limits$num_cat.factor[2] <- "No change in ART regiment before baseline"


surv.obj <- with(demdata_2, Surv(time, event.num==1))

my_cph_uni <- sapply(c("age_gt50.factor", "gender.factor", "tb", "ade", "DTG_pre.factor"), function(x)
                     as.formula(paste("surv.obj~ ", x, "+ strat(study_site.factor)")))

#Age > 50
unimod.age_gt50 <- cph(surv.obj ~ age_gt50.factor + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.age_gt50 <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.age_gt50))
ano.age_gt50 <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.age_gt50))

# gender
unimod.gender <- cph(surv.obj ~ gender.factor + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.gender <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.gender))
ano.gender <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.gender))

#Tb
unimod.tb <- cph(surv.obj ~ tb + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.tb <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.tb))
ano.tb <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.tb))

#ADE
unimod.ade <- cph(surv.obj ~ ade_type + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.ade <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.ade))
ano.ade <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.ade))

#Number of Regiment
dd <- datadist(demdata_2)
options(datadist= 'dd')
unimod.nu <- cph(surv.obj ~ num_cat.factor + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.nu <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.nu))
ano.nu <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.nu))

#DTG pre and post
unimod.dtg_pre <- cph(surv.obj ~ DTG_pre.factor + strat(study_site.factor),  data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.pre <- as.data.frame(summary(unimod.dtg_pre))
ano.pre <- as.data.frame(anova(unimod.dtg_pre))

mod.surv1  <- cph(Surv(time, event.num) ~ age_gt50.factor + gender.factor + tb +ade_type  + DTG_pre.factor + num_cat.factor + strat(study_site.factor), data = demdata_2, surv = TRUE, x = TRUE, y =TRUE)
summ.surv1 <- as.data.frame(summary(mod.surv1))
ano.surv1 <- as.data.frame(anova(mod.surv1))

#Table
var <- c(" Age greater then or equal to 50 ref(Less then 50)", "Gender ref(Male)","Tb (ref = No)", "AIDS-defining illness at baseline (ref = No)", "DTG period ref(Post DTG)", "Number of changes in ART before baseline (ref = No change in ART regiment before baseline)")

hr <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$Effect[2],digits =3), round(summ.gender$Effect[2],digits =3),round(summ.tb$Effect[2],digits =3),round(summ.ade$Effect[2],digits =3),round(summ.pre$Effect[2],digits =3),round(summ.nu$Effect[2],digits =3))

ll <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3), round(summ.gender$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.tb$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.ade$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.pre$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.nu$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3))

ul <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3), round(summ.gender$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.tb$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.ade$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.pre$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3),round(summ.nu$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3))

p <- c(round(ano.age_gt50$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.gender$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.tb$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.ade$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.pre$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.nu$P[1],digits =3))

uni_surv <-  data.frame(var,hr,ll,ul,p)

hr_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$Effect[2],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$Effect[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$Effect[6],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$Effect[8],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$Effect[10],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$Effect[12],digits =3))

ll_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[2],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[6],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[8],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[10],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Lower 0.95`[12],digits =3))

ul_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[2],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[6],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[8],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[10],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$`Upper 0.95`[12],digits =3))

p_f <- c(round(ano.surv1$P[1],digits =3),round(ano.surv1$P[2],digits =3),round(ano.surv1$P[3],digits =3),round(ano.surv1$P[4],digits =3),round(ano.surv1$P[5],digits =3),round(ano.surv1$P[6],digits =3))

mod_surv <- data.frame(var,hr_f,ll_f,ul_f,p_f)
```

# **Time updated analysis for AIM 2: all sites** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

* Since the start date, rna_d and DTG switch date is same for some IDs, in these cases start_date(time0) is same as end_date(time1) giving warning for Surv function, we have subtracted 1 date from baseline to define start date and one day from rna_d if the rna_d and baseline are same.

* Viral load values have been carried forward for one year at baseline also.

* Age is computed at baseline

* Some IDs to check the datasets:

```{r check , echo= FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
check1 <- all %>% filter(patient_id == "1054" | patient_id == "2040" | patient_id == "5046" | patient_id == "5036"| patient_id == "30729" | patient_id == "70044" | patient_id == "70201" | patient_id == "70232" | patient_id == "70802" | patient_id == "70996") %>% select(patient_id,time0,time1,DTG_d,start_date,end_date,rna_d,event,viral_failure.n,baseline)
print(check1,type = "html", include.rownames = F)

```

## Cox Proportional Hazard Models (all sites) 


(tab content)

<br>
```{r univariate time updated analysis ,echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
all <- within(all, age_gender_period <- relevel(factor(age_gender_period), ref = "Younger male post"))
all <- within(all, period <- relevel(factor(period), ref = "Post DTG warning"))
all <- within(all, gender.factor <- relevel(factor(gender.factor), ref = "Male"))
all <- within(all, age_gt50.factor <- relevel(factor(age_gt50.factor), ref = "Less then 50"))
all <- within(all, viral_failure.n <- relevel(factor(viral_failure.n), ref = "No"))
all <- within(all, num_cat.factor <- relevel(factor(num_cat.factor), ref = "One ART regiment before baseline"))

# surv.obj <- with(all, Surv(time0,time1, event==1))
# 
# my_cph_uni <- sapply(c("age_gt50.factor", "gender.factor", "tb", "ade", "period"), function(x)
#   as.formula(paste("surv.obj~ ", x, "+ strat(study_site.factor)")))

#Age > 50
unimod.age_gt50 <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + strata(study_site.factor),data = all,cluster =patient_id)
summ.age_gt50 <- summary(unimod.age_gt50)
ano.age_gt50 <- summ.age_gt50$coefficients[6]

# gender
unimod.gender <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ gender.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all,cluster =patient_id)
summ.gender <- summary(unimod.gender)
ano.gender <- summ.gender$coefficients[6]

#Tb
unimod.tb <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ tb + strata(study_site.factor), data = all,cluster= patient_id)
summ.tb <- summary(unimod.tb)
ano.tb <- summ.tb$coefficients[6]

#ADE
unimod.ade <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ ade_type + strata(study_site.factor), data = all,cluster =patient_id)
summ.ade <- summary(unimod.ade)
ano.ade <- summ.ade$coefficients[6]

#Number of Regiment
unimod.nu <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ num_cat.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all,cluster=patient_id)
summ.nu <- summary(unimod.nu)
ano.nu <- summ.nu$coefficients[6]

#DTG pre and post
unimod.dtg_pre <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ period + strata(study_site.factor),data = all,cluster=patient_id)
summ.pre <- summary(unimod.dtg_pre)
ano.pre <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

#Viral failure.n
unimod.vs <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ viral_failure.n + strata(study_site.factor),data = all,cluster=patient_id)
summ.vs <- summary(unimod.vs)
ano.vs <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

mod.surv1  <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + gender.factor + tb +ade_type  + period + num_cat.factor + viral_failure.n + strata(study_site.factor), data = all,cluster=patient_id)
summ.surv1 <- summary(mod.surv1)
ano.surv1 <- summ.surv1$coefficients


#Table
var <- c(" Age greater then or equal to 50 ref(Less then 50)", "Gender ref(Male)","Tb (ref = No)", "AIDS-defining illness at baseline (ref = No)", "DTG period ref(Post DTG)", "Number of changes in ART before baseline (ref = No change in ART regiment before baseline)", "Viral failure (ref = No)")

hr <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[1],digits =3))

ll <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[3],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[3],digits =3))

ul <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[4],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[4],digits =3))

p <- c(round(ano.age_gt50,digits =3),round(ano.gender,digits =3),round(ano.tb,digits =3),round(ano.ade,digits =3),round(ano.pre,digits=3),round(ano.nu,digits =3),round(ano.vs,digits =3))

uni_s <-  data.frame(var,hr,ll,ul,p)

hr_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[2],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[5],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[6],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[7],digits =3))

ll_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[15],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[16],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[17],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[18],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[19],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[20],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[21],digits =3))

ul_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[22],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[23],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[24],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[25],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[26],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[27],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[28],digits =3))

p_f <- c(round(ano.surv1[36],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[37],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[38],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[39],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[40],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[41],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[42],digits =3))


mod_s <- data.frame(var,hr_f,ll_f,ul_f,p_f)

```

## Graphs 

(tab content)

* Data for graph has missing viral load values, as the new dataset created has increment of a quarter.

<br>
``` {r graph cox Males without viral failure, warning=FALSE,out.width="50%", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(gee)
library(broom)
library(geepack)
ld <- demdata_2 %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(date = list(seq(as.Date(baseline), as.Date(l_alive_d), by="quarter"))) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(date))
ld$DTG_d <- as.Date(ld$DTG_d)
ld$l_alive_d <- as.Date(ld$l_alive_d)
ld$date <- as.Date(ld$date)

ld <- ld %>% group_by(patient_id) %>% mutate(date = ifelse(row_number() == n(), max(DTG_d,l_alive_d), date))
ld$date <- as.Date(ld$date)
ld$date <- ifelse(is.na(ld$date),ld$l_alive_d,ld$date)
ld$date <- as.Date(ld$date)
ld <- ld %>% select(patient_id,DTG_d,date,tb,ade_type,study_site.factor,switch,gender.factor,art_sd,art_id,birth_d,switch,l_alive_d,age)
# ld2 <- all %>% select(patient_id,start_date,viral_failure.n,rna_d,age.new,viral_failure)
# ld   <- full_join(ld,ld2,by = "patient_id")
# ld <- ld %>% distinct(date,rna_d,.keep_all = TRUE)
ld$event <- with(ld,ifelse(date >= DTG_d,1,0))
ld$event <- ifelse(is.na(ld$event),0,ld$event)
# ld  <-  ld %>% group_by(patient_id) %>% fill(viral_failure, .direction = "down")
# ld$diff <- ld$date - ld$rna_d
# #ld$diff <- abs(as.numeric(difftime(ld$date,ld$rna_d, units = "days")))
# ld$indi <- with(ld,ifelse( diff >= 0 & diff <= 365,1,0))
# ld$indi <- ifelse(is.na(ld$indi),0,ld$indi)
# ld <- ld %>% fill(viral_failure, .direction = "down")
# ld$viral_failure.n <- ifelse(ld$indi == 1,ld$viral_failure, NA)
# ld$viral_failure.n <- ifelse(is.na(ld$viral_failure.n),"No",ld$viral_failure.n)
#ld$viral_failure.n <- ifelse(ld$viral_failure.n == 2, "Yes",
#                                 ifelse(ld$viral_failure.n == 1, "No",ld$viral_failure.n))



dmm <- ld %>% filter(gender.factor == "Male")
dmm$date <- as.numeric(dmm$date)
mm <- geeglm(event ~  tb + ade_type + (ns(age,df =4))*(ns(date,df=4)) + study_site.factor , id = patient_id, data = dmm, family = binomial)

new.data2_haiti <- data.frame(date = rep(c(17198:19082),5), age = c(rep(20,1885),rep(30,1885),rep(40,1885),rep(50,1885),rep(60,1885)),
                        study_site.factor = "Haiti", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")
new.data2_haiti$date <- as.Date(new.data2_haiti$date)


p3 <- predict(mm, newdata = new.data2_haiti)
prob3 <- (exp(p3)/(1+exp(p3)))


new.data2_brazil <- data.frame(date = rep(c(17198:19082),5), age = c(rep(20,1885),rep(30,1885),rep(40,1885),rep(50,1885),rep(60,1885)),
                        study_site.factor = "Brazil", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")
new.data2_brazil$date <- as.Date(new.data2_brazil$date)

p3_brazil <- predict(mm, newdata = new.data2_brazil)
prob3_brazil <- (exp(p3_brazil)/(1+exp(p3_brazil)))

new.data2_honduras <- data.frame(date = rep(c(17198:19082),5), age = c(rep(20,1885),rep(30,1885),rep(40,1885),rep(50,1885),rep(60,1885)),
                                 study_site.factor = "Honduras", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")
new.data2_honduras$date <- as.Date(new.data2_honduras$date)

p3_honduras <- predict(mm, newdata = new.data2_honduras)
prob3_honduras <- (exp(p3_honduras)/(1+exp(p3_honduras)))

new.data2_chile <- data.frame(date = rep(c(17198:19082),5), age= c(rep(20,1885),rep(30,1885),rep(40,1885),rep(50,1885),rep(60,1885)),
                              study_site.factor = "Chile", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")
new.data2_chile$date <- as.Date(new.data2_chile$date)

p3_chile <- predict(mm, newdata = new.data2_chile)
prob3_chile <- (exp(p3_chile)/(1+exp(p3_chile)))


prob_avg <- 0.28*prob3_brazil + 0.59*prob3 + 0.10*prob3_chile + 0.026*prob3_honduras

#par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 8.1))
plot(c(17198,19082),c(0,1), xlab ="Baseline date", ylab ="Probability of switching to DTG", type = "n", axes = FALSE, main="Weighted probability of switching to DTG for Males")
axis(2)
axis.Date(1, at=seq(min(new.data2_brazil$date), max(new.data2_brazil$date), by="years"), format="%b-%Y")
abline(v= c(as.numeric(as.Date("2018-06-01", format = "%Y-%m-%d")),as.numeric(as.Date("2019-08-01", format = "%Y-%m-%d"))), col="gray")
```

``` {r graph cox females without viral failure, warning=FALSE,out.width="50%", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(gee)

dmf <- ld %>% filter(gender.factor == "Female")

             data = dmf, family = binomial)

new.data2_haiti <- data.frame(date = rep(c(17198:19082),5), age = c(rep(20,1885),rep(30,1885),rep(40,1885),rep(50,1885),rep(60,1885)),
                        study_site.factor = "Haiti", ade_type = "No", tb = "No")
```

## Cox Proportional Hazard Models 
<br>
(tab content)

```{r univariate time updated analysis haiti ,echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, age_gender_period <- relevel(factor(age_gender_period), ref = "Younger male post"))
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, period <- relevel(factor(period), ref = "Post DTG warning"))
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, gender.factor <- relevel(factor(gender.factor), ref = "Male"))
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, age_gt50.factor <- relevel(factor(age_gt50.factor), ref = "Less then 50"))
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, viral_failure.n <- relevel(factor(viral_failure.n), ref = "No"))
all_haiti <- within(all_haiti, num_cat.factor <- relevel(factor(num_cat.factor), ref = "One ART regiment before baseline"))


#Age > 50
unimod.age_gt50 <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_haiti,cluster =patient_id)
summ.age_gt50 <- summary(unimod.age_gt50)
ano.age_gt50 <- summ.age_gt50$coefficients[6]

# gender
unimod.gender <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ gender.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_haiti,cluster =patient_id)
summ.gender <- summary(unimod.gender)
ano.gender <- summ.gender$coefficients[6]

#Tb
unimod.tb <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ tb + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_haiti,cluster= patient_id)
summ.tb <- summary(unimod.tb)
ano.tb <- summ.tb$coefficients[6]


#Number of Regiment
unimod.nu <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ num_cat.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_haiti,cluster=patient_id)
summ.nu <- summary(unimod.nu)
ano.nu <- summ.nu$coefficients[6]

#DTG pre and post
unimod.dtg_pre <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ period + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_haiti,cluster=patient_id)
summ.pre <- summary(unimod.dtg_pre)
ano.pre <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

#Viral failure.n
unimod.vs <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ viral_failure.n + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_haiti,cluster=patient_id)
summ.vs <- summary(unimod.vs)
ano.vs <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

mod.surv1  <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + gender.factor + tb  + period + num_cat.factor + viral_failure.n  + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_haiti,cluster=patient_id)
summ.surv1 <- summary(mod.surv1)
ano.surv1 <- summ.surv1$coefficients


#Table
var <- c(" Age greater then or equal to 50 ref(Less then 50)", "Gender ref(Male)","Tb (ref = No)", "DTG period ref(Post DTG)", "Number of changes in ART before baseline (ref = No change in ART regiment before baseline)", "Viral failure (ref = No)")

hr <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[1],digits =3))

ll <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[3],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[3],digits =3))

ul <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[4],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[4],digits =3))

p <- c(round(ano.age_gt50,digits =3),round(ano.gender,digits =3),round(ano.tb,digits =3),round(ano.pre,digits=3),round(ano.nu,digits =3),round(ano.vs,digits =3))

uni_s <-  data.frame(var,hr,ll,ul,p)

hr_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[2],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[5],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[6],digits =3))

ll_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[13],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[14],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[15],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[16],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[17],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[18],digits =3))

ul_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[19],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[20],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[21],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[22],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[23],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[24],digits =3))

p_f <- c(round(ano.surv1[31],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[32],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[33],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[34],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[35],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[36],digits =3))


mod_s <- data.frame(var,hr_f,ll_f,ul_f,p_f)

```

```{r univariate time updated analysis except haiti ,echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
unimod.age_gt50 <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_other,cluster =patient_id)
summ.age_gt50 <- summary(unimod.age_gt50)
ano.age_gt50 <- summ.age_gt50$coefficients[6]

# gender
unimod.gender <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ gender.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_other,cluster =patient_id)
summ.gender <- summary(unimod.gender)
ano.gender <- summ.gender$coefficients[6]

#Tb
unimod.tb <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ tb + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_other,cluster= patient_id)
summ.tb <- summary(unimod.tb)
ano.tb <- summ.tb$coefficients[6]

#ADE
unimod.ade <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ ade_type + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_other,cluster =patient_id)
summ.ade <- summary(unimod.ade)
ano.ade <- summ.ade$coefficients[6]

#Number of Regiment
unimod.nu <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ num_cat.factor + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_other,cluster=patient_id)
summ.nu <- summary(unimod.nu)
ano.nu <- summ.nu$coefficients[6]

#DTG pre and post
unimod.dtg_pre <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ period + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_other,cluster=patient_id)
summ.pre <- summary(unimod.dtg_pre)
ano.pre <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

#Viral failure.n
unimod.vs <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ viral_failure.n + strata(study_site.factor),data = all_other,cluster=patient_id)
summ.vs <- summary(unimod.vs)
ano.vs <- summ.pre$coefficients[6]

mod.surv1  <- coxph(Surv(time0, time1,event) ~ age_gt50.factor + gender.factor + tb +ade_type  + period + num_cat.factor + viral_failure.n + strata(study_site.factor), data = all_other,cluster=patient_id)
summ.surv1 <- summary(mod.surv1)
ano.surv1 <- summ.surv1$coefficients


#Table
var <- c(" Age greater then or equal to 50 ref(Less then 50)", "Gender ref(Male)","Tb (ref = No)", "AIDS-defining illness at baseline (ref = No)", "DTG period ref(Post DTG)", "Number of changes in ART before baseline (ref = No change in ART regiment before baseline)", "Viral failure (ref = No)")

hr <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[1],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[1],digits =3))

ll <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[3],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[3],digits =3))

ul <- c(round(summ.age_gt50$conf.int[4],digits =3), round(summ.gender$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.tb$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.ade$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.pre$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.nu$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.vs$conf.int[4],digits =3))

p <- c(round(ano.age_gt50,digits =3),round(ano.gender,digits =3),round(ano.tb,digits =3),round(ano.ade,digits =3),round(ano.pre,digits=3),round(ano.nu,digits =3),round(ano.vs,digits =3))

uni_s <-  data.frame(var,hr,ll,ul,p)

hr_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[1],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[2],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[3],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[4],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[5],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[6],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[7],digits =3))

ll_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[15],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[16],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[17],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[18],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[19],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[20],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[21],digits =3))

ul_f <- c(round(summ.surv1$conf.int[22],digits =3), round(summ.surv1$conf.int[23],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[24],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[25],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[26],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[27],digits =3),round(summ.surv1$conf.int[28],digits =3))

p_f <- c(round(ano.surv1[36],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[37],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[38],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[39],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[40],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[41],digits =3),round(ano.surv1[42],digits =3))


mod_s <- data.frame(var,hr_f,ll_f,ul_f,p_f)

```
